note: Kodi for Android APKs the kodi-android job (kodi-addon.yml) installs in the emulator, pinned by SHA-256 (from mirrors.kodi.tv <file>?sha256). Kodi publishes no x86_64 APK; Kodi 22 x86 exists only as a Piers nightly (the mirror prunes old nightlies: move the pin to a newer one, or to the 22.0 release, when it is gone).
